data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m (2014: GBP 28.0m) due primarily to a reduction in the assessment of third party liability claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2015 and a release of catastrophe loads on 2014 year of account as policies come off risk (2014: better than anticipated experience in medical malpractice, a deterioration on motor lines of business and a release of catastrophe loads on 2013 year of account).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Expected ultimate gross loss across all years of account of GBP 76.2m (of which GBP 57.5m had been incurred at year end); significant catastrophe exposure considered in reserving.
Gross incurred losses from the international cat events of GBP 21.3m with a further provision of GBP 7.7m.

named_events.loss_description: Expected ultimate gross loss across all years of account of GBP 76.2m (of which GBP 57.5m had been incurred at year end).
Gross incurred losses of GBP 21.3m with a further provision of GBP 7.7m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross favourable prior-year development in 2015 of GBP 27.1m (a release of c.7.9% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven mainly by favourable development on third party liability reserves (notably reductions on 2013 and prior years) and releases of catastrophe loadings as policies came off risk. This was partially offset by less favourable experience in motor lines. The gross surplus is consistent with a net release reported elsewhere (net release c.GBP 17.8m) after reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: a reduction in the assessment of third party liability claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2015
a release of catastrophe loads on 2014 year of account as policies come off risk
better than anticipated experience in medical malpractice
a deterioration on motor lines of business
The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 17.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2014: GBP 22.8m).
In 2015, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m (2014: GBP 28.0m)
data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement sourced from the explicit narrative in the claims development section stating an "overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m" (gross). A net release of GBP 17.8m is also reported in the claims note (net of reinsurance). A gross claims development triangle is present but contains an aggregate "2010 and prior" column which is excluded from diagonal calculations per rules. Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Miscellaneous') have been approximated to standard Lloyd's categories. All monetary fields in main summary are in millions (GBP). The claims development triangle values are reported in thousands in the _claims_triangle structure.
